name: Checkout and setup environment
description: Git checkout if not already checked out, get node_modules from cache if available, set up Node.js, run yarn install

is-high-risk-environment.description: Use a secure setup without caching (true = secure, false = optimized for speed).

fetch-depth.description: Depth of the Git history to fetch.

filter.description: Partially clone the repository with the given Git filter. This is passed to actions/checkout; for example, tree:0 performs a treeless partial clone.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or SHA to checkout.

cache-node-modules.description: Enable node_modules caching for the prepare job. When is-high-risk-environment is true, only saves (write-only); when false, reads and writes.

node-version.description: Node.js version to use. If not provided, will use the version specified in the `.nvmrc` file.

skip-allow-scripts.description: Skip the `yarn allow-scripts` step. If your job does not need this step, skipping it may save some time.

yarn-install-max-retries.description: Maximum number of retries for the `yarn --immutable` install command.

yarn-tarball.description: URL to a Yarn tarball to use instead of the default.

force-setup.description: Force checkout, Node setup, and cache restore to run even if the node_modules cache exists. Use this with cache-node-modules when later steps in the same job ne

persist-credentials.description: Whether to persist the GitHub token in the checked-out repository. This is passed to the `actions/checkout` step. Setting this to false can help prevent acciden

skip-install.description: Skip all Yarn install steps. The repository is still checked out and Node.js is still set up, but dependencies are not installed.
